chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 24, short curly black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard yellow hoodie and dark jeans
chars.NEIGHBOUR: an elegant Moroccan woman about 30, shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, cream blazer over an emerald green blouse, small gold hoop earrings
chars.BROTHER: a Moroccan teenage boy about 15, buzz cut, red football jersey and grey shorts
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother about 50, burgundy headscarf, beige djellaba

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. Seen from a modern Casablanca office doorway: NEIGHBOUR stands at her glass desk smiling warmly and waving him in, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible; NARRATOR in the foreground from behind-shoulder, stunned and delighted. Morning light, calm background at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. NARRATOR leans over NEIGHBOUR's office desk holding two coffee cups, grinning and saying good morning; NEIGHBOUR looks up from her laptop amused. Bright modern open office in Casablanca, head-to-waist framing, faces visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical, dreamy daydream style with a soft pink glow and small floating hearts. NARRATOR drives a small car along the Casablanca corniche, NEIGHBOUR in the passenger seat laughing, seen through the windshield, faces visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical, dreamy daydream style with soft pink glow. The car is parked by the sea at the Casablanca corniche at sunset; NEIGHBOUR leans out of the window pointing at the sea, suggesting they stop for fresh air; NARRATOR beside her blushing with a goofy smile. Faces visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical, comic. Small Moroccan bedroom in the morning: BROTHER stands at the open door banging on it and shouting with a teasing grin; NARRATOR jolts awake in bed under a blanket, hair messy, eyes wide. Faces visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. NARRATOR, now in a crisp white shirt and navy blazer instead of the hoodie, proudly fixes his collar in front of a wardrobe mirror in a simple Moroccan bedroom, smiling confidently. Face visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. Moroccan family living room with low sofas: MOM hands a small folded paper with an address to NARRATOR (white shirt and navy blazer), she smiles proudly, he holds his phone ready to write it. Head-to-waist framing, faces visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, vertical. NARRATOR (white shirt and navy blazer) stands confused at the reception of a big modern office lobby in Casablanca, looking around at an empty glass desk, puzzled expression, a stranger in a suit sitting on a waiting bench behind him. Face visible in the centre.
